data.name: Spell Combat
data.description: An eldritch scion can only use spell combat while in a state of mystic focus (see eldritch pool, above). At 8th level, an eldritch scion can use spell combat at any time. This ability alters spell combat.

raw_tokens.value: Eldritch Scion Class Feature.Magus Class Feature.SpecialQuality.Extraordinary

An eldritch scion can only use spell combat while in a state of mystic focus (see eldritch pool, above). At 8th level, an eldritch scion can use spell combat at any time. This ability alters spell combat.
